beats.text: On the anniversary of his second inauguration, Trump gave a hundred-and-four-minute White House briefing that opened with a slideshow of ICE mugshots from the Minneapolis raids.

beats.caption: Here's the book. These are all things we have.
beats.label: via India Today

beats.text: He held up a thick binder of what he called three hundred sixty-five wins.

beats.caption: All the page, after page, after page, individual things.
beats.label: via KARE 11

beats.text: According to PolitiFact's review of the briefing, the marathon speech was long on boasts and short on precision.

beats.caption: I could stand here and read it for a week, and we wouldn't be finished.
beats.label: via KARE 11

beats.text: CNN cut away mid-broadcast; anchor Brianna Keilar called it winding even by Trumpian standards.

beats.caption: Oh, I'm glad my finger wasn't in. That's so good.
beats.label: via KARE 11

beats.text: Somewhere in there, the binder itself took a swing at the president.

beats.caption: That could have done some damage, but you know what? I wouldn't have shown the pain.
beats.label: via KARE 11
